{{Vanilla|Torch}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''torch''' is a basic light source. [[Matcha Flavoured]] doubles its recipe output and adds an early recipe from dry grass.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Coal or charcoal on a stick makes 8 torches, where vanilla makes 4. Short dry grass on a stick makes 4. The vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/torch.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/torch_from_short_dry_grass.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
